name: Aimake Videos
tagline: Viral AI video generator with trend templates
description: Aimake Videos turns your photo into trending vertical AI videos with sound. Export 9:16 videos ready for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts — no watermark, sound included, credits back if a video fails.
